data.message: Oh, dear author, youve misunderstood me. Im not suggesting you copy that tank mod. I simply meant that while the tank in that mod can fire, the effect is poorit doesn't actually destroy the structures Ive built. It just firesproducing the visual effect of a shotbut lacks any destructive capability. I certainly wasn't asking you to plagiarize it.

replies.message: @asd Oh yeah, I think it's best for the destruction effect that the game knows the explosion. Let's see what can be done.

data.message:
Hello, dear author. Thank you so much for your amazing mod!The comment section doesnt allow me to post such a long message, so I put what I wanted to say in the pictures. Could you please take a look?
I dont know much about game or mod development, so some of the things I said may not be technically correct. I hope you understand what I mean. Thank you again!

replies.message: I'll see what I can do, but I don't like to take existing mods to the fact that it's a lot more work and even if it doesn't seem like it, it's my first mod, so I'm super grateful for the great feedback. I looked at your photo, the catch with other mods is reverse engineering, a mod already wrapped in a DLL file cannot be easily deciphered again, think of it like hieroglyphics. I'll see what I get done next month.

data.message: Hi, dear creator! I really love your mod. Would it be possible to add a cannon attack function to the helicopter? I want to use it to destroy the wooden buildings Ive built myself. Its a shame that the helicopter can only fly around and cant attack!

replies.message: @asd I'll devote myself to your idea next month and see if I can get this implemented. Thanks for the nice feedback!
